This is a good time to maintain the nextruder.  If you experiencing stuck filament, non-extrusion, etc.  You will find debris in the motor and PG assembly.  

I also upgraded the main plate and the idlers using this enhancement by KentO:

https://www.printables.com/model/1072020-mk4s-bogie-idler-main-plate
you also have to detach some cables during this step.

replies.content: maybe the manual was changed but as of now the cables were removed in previous steps already.
As of my reading it was a bit confusing.  You were to remove all the cables on the left except the largest.  I didn't realize it meant the one above that also.
